title: A merge trial in progress when the loop restarts onto a new release finishes on its own verdict
description: The real merge writer's flight launches its trial as a detached run of the loop's own code; the loop restarts while the trial is in progress (its watcher dies as the process would), and the next loop adopts the run from the persisted state: the head lands on the trial's own verdict with one run, no unpushed refusal, and no settled open intent.

steps.name: Exercise a merge trial across a loop restart
